what_happened: Task 532's described defect (roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate silently aborting against a Stage-based ROADMAP.md) is the exact same issue already fully fixed by task 371 (completed 2026-10-10, archived at specs/archive/371_roadmap_generator_stage_layout_and_silent_abort/), including the stage-layout round-trip, the permanent loud destructive-overwrite refusal, and the always-present stderr marker. Live re-verification today against this repo's actual specs/ROADMAP.md and a synthetic unknown-layout fixture confirms both code paths work exactly as task 371's summary describes: --regenerate --dry-run on the real classic-layout ROADMAP.md exits 0 with a minimal, state-accurate diff; against an unrecognized layout it exits 1 with a named ERROR: line and no write. The one follow-up bug task 371 recorded (prune_next_body() CLI-flag-parsing) was also already fixed by task 388. No implementation work remains; research recommends closing task 532 as covered-by-closed (371) rather than dispatching a plan/implement phase.
